newsitem.title: FRANCE: Mobutu, preparing to return home, urges Zaire truce.
newsitem.headline: Mobutu, preparing to return home, urges Zaire truce.

text.p: Ailing Zairean President Mobutu Sese Seko called on Thursday for a ceasefire in his strife-torn country and the creation of a national council to find a solution to the crisis.

His appeal was issued on the eve of his scheduled return home to Kinshasa. A spokesman said the Zairean leader would leave Nice airport at 8 a.m. (0700 GMT) on Friday and arrive in his capital the same day at 3 p.m. (1400 GMT).

"At a time when I am preparing to return to my country to find myself again among my people, I invite all Zaireans to rise together," he said in a written statement sent to news agencies in Paris from his villa on the French Riviera.
Mobutu said he welcomed all regional and international efforts to bring peace to Zaire.
Mobutu's statement was issued a day after he left hospital for a new bout of treatment following an operation for prostate cancer last August since when he has spent most of his time in Europe.

Mobutu's son and spokesman, Nzanga, has said his father did not rule out talks with rebels who have been pressing ever deeper into Zaire from the east but that had to be done in agreement with the government and parliament.
